nom: NOTO Botanics Safe Sun SPF 30 Invisible Serum Sunscreen

concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers report their skin feels and looks hydrated after use, describing a moist or glowy finish; no reviewer describes it as drying.

extraits.texte: I purchased it for my sunscreen-hating boyfriend. He actually uses this product and loves the smell and how non-greasy the formula is.

I love everything NOTO makes but dang this is amazing. After using it my skin looks so glowly and healthy I dont even need to wear much makeup. Also it works. My skin has stayed hydrated and bright. Smells so nice too - i love the ingredients so much !

This is my 3rd bottle of the Safe Sun serum and I love this product so much. Doesn't leave my skin oily at all and leaves my skin feeling hydrated. I genuinely believe the niacinamides have helped the overall quality of my skin!
This sunscreen is great! It's goes on well and it not too thick and/or greasy, absorbing well with no noticeable scent. Highly recommend!
I love this spf acts like a moisturizer, doesn't pill, and doesn't leave a white cast. It's super lightweight and I will be rebuying!

reserve: Only 6 reviews are available, none specify the reviewer's skin type or a named skin concern beyond hydration and greasiness, and no critical review is present, so segmentation by skin type and broader concerns cannot be supported.
